lead: A `loop-goal.toml` check filed in a crate that cannot reach the surface has a *fourth* repair: leave the check where it is and make the surface a parameter the binary fills.
body: It applies when the named crate owns the *decision* and a crate it may not name owns only the *data* the decision reads — adding the dependency would put the test one layer above its rule. `crates/nvs-server/src/schedule.rs`'s `Fires` is the shape: a trait the crate declares and `nvs-cli`, which names both sides, implements.
